description: This file contains unit tests for IPC (Inter-Process Communication) mechanisms related to a session server, including connection handling, state setting, pinging, and configuration, using the Google Test framework.

methods.name: PerformSetStateShouldReturnFalseWhenNoAppIsConnected
methods.description: Test that setting the session server state returns false when no application is connected.

methods.name: PerformPingShouldReturnFalseWhenNoAppIsConnected
methods.description: Test that ping returns false when no application is connected.

methods.name: ShouldFailToCreateClientWhenServerIsNotRunning
methods.description: Test that client creation fails when the server is not running.

methods.name: ShouldConnectToRialtoSessionServer
methods.description: Test successful connection to the Rialto session server.

methods.name: ShouldFailToConnectToTheSameAppTwice
methods.description: Test that attempting to connect twice to the same app fails.

methods.name: ShouldRemoveClient
methods.description: Test that removing a client causes subsequent state set attempts to fail.

methods.name: ShouldSuccessfullySetState
methods.description: Test that setting the session server state to INACTIVE succeeds.

methods.name: ShouldFailToSetStateWhenFailResponseIsReceived
methods.description: Test that setting the state fails when a fail response is received.

methods.name: ShouldSuccessfullyPing
methods.description: Test that ping succeeds when server responds positively.

methods.name: ShouldFailToPingWhenFailResponseIsReceived
methods.description: Test that ping fails when a fail response is received.

methods.name: ShouldForwardStateChangedIndicationToSessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Test that state change indications are forwarded to the app manager.

methods.name: ShouldForwardAckEventToSessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Test that acknowledgment events are forwarded to the app manager.

methods.name: ShouldForwardNotRunningStateChangeToSessionServerAppManagerWhenUnexpectedlyDisconnected
methods.description: Test that a not-running state change is forwarded when disconnected unexpectedly.

methods.name: ShouldSuccessfullySetLogLevels
methods.description: Test that setting log levels succeeds.

methods.name: ShouldFailToSetLogLevels
methods.description: Test that setting log levels fails when server responds with failure.

methods.name: ShouldFailToSetConfiguration
methods.description: Test that setting configuration fails when server responds with failure.
